name: io.github.langmail/langmail-mcp
title: Langmail MCP for your own Stalwart: email, calendar and contacts
description: Self-hosted MCP server for Stalwart: email, calendar and contacts over JMAP, CalDAV and CardDAV.

environmentVariables.name: STALWART_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Stalwart server (JMAP, CalDAV and CardDAV), e.g. https://mail.example.com

environmentVariables.name: STALWART_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Account login name, usually the mail address; use together with STALWART_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.name: STALWART_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: App password for STALWART_USERNAME, created in Stalwart's account manager

environmentVariables.name: STALWART_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token such as a Stalwart API key, as an alternative to STALWART_USERNAME and STALWART_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport: stdio (the default) or http, which serves Streamable HTTP at /mcp

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required with MCP_TRANSPORT=http: the secret callers send as Authorization: Bearer; at least 16 characters

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP transport: address to listen on

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP transport: port to listen on

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: HTTP transport: the address callers reach the server under, e.g. behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level for stderr: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace or silent

environmentVariables.name: LANGMAIL_MCP_ALLOW_UNSUBSCRIBE_POST
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let unsubscribe_from_list send the RFC 8058 one-click request to the sender's URL; off by default

environmentVariables.name: LANGMAIL_MCP_ALLOW_REMOTE_IMAGES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let preview_email load a message's remote images through this server; off by default
